def slugify(text):
    if not text:
        return ''
    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace non-alphanumeric characters with dashes, then collapse multiple dashes
    import re
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    text = re.sub(r'-+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing dashes
    text = text.strip('-')
    return text
